Commentary.Commentary: We are all set for the run chase. The umpires have made their way out to the middle followed by the India Women players who take their position on the field. Fargana Hoque and Murshida Khatun are the openers for Bangladesh Women and they will be looking to get off to a good start. Deepti Sharma has been handed the new ball and will begin proceedings. Let's go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, India Women will be silently confident in defending this total with the outfield really slow and the pitch assisting the spinners. They will be looking to take early wickets and build the scoreboard pressure on their opponents. Bangladesh Women will want to take the momentum from the second half of the first inning into their batting and will be hoping that their batters click. We are in for an interesting run chase. Will Bangladesh Women be able to get over the line? Or will India Women defend this total with ease? We will find out soon. Do join us shortly for the reply.

India Women got off to a rollicking start scoring 59 runs in the Powerplay and putting up an opening partnership of 96 runs. Disaster struck as Smriti Mandhana was run out 3 runs short of her half-century which caused Shafali Verma to slow down and consolidate. She reached her fifty but was dismissed playing an unnecessary short to Rumana Ahmed. The Bangladesh Women's spinners began building the pressure with some tight bowling and that resulted in another couple of wickets for Rumana Ahmed on consecutive deliveries. She dropped Jemimah Rodrigues on the Hat-trick ball which resulted in them reaching close to the 160-run mark. Rumana Ahmed was the pick of the bowlers taking three wickets with Salma Khatun chipping in with one.

Bangladesh Women have done exceedingly well to pull things back here! India Women at one stage looked like they would be touching the 200-run mark but fell away in the last 10 overs. Nonetheless, they have a reasonable total of 159 runs on the board and will be looking to come out to defend this target. Bangladesh Women looked to be clueless in the first half of the inning and conceded 91 runs in the first 10 overs. They will know that they have given themselves a chance to look to complete a remarkable run chase.

Just a couple of runs to end and it's been a solid fightback from Bangladesh Women. This is bolwed on a shorter length and outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues skips down the track and heaves it away towards wide long on for a brace. India Women finish with a score of 159/5 on the board.
Nicely played! Around off stump, Jemimah Rodrigues gets inside the line of the ball and paddles it past short fine leg for a couple of runs.
darted in full and straight, Pooja Vastrakar jams it down to long on for a single.
Pooja Vastrakar has made he way out to the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT! Deepti Sharma perishes whilst looking for the big shot and Salma Khatun gets her first wicket of the game. This is tossed up, outside off and Sharma steps out of her crease. Sharma looks to play it down the ground but has to reach for it and ends up slicing it. The ball pops up towards the backward point region where Sanjida Akter takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Sanjida Akter b Salma Khatun

Commentary.Commentary: Flighted delivery, outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues shuffles across and plays the slog-sweep straight towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated up, full and around off, this is driven straight towards cover.
Flatter one, around off, this is played late and past short third man for a couple of runs.

SIX! Just over! A brilliant effort in the deep but Deepti Sharma does clear the fence. Tossed up again, Sharma dances down the track and smokes it right back over the bowler's head. The fielder from long on moves swiftly to her right and leaps up but can't get to the ball.
On the pads, this is worked away towards mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Nicely struck! Tossed up around middle, Jemimah Rodrigues steps down the track and drags the heave one-bounce into the wide long on fence for a boundary.
Flighted, on a length and on off stump, Deepti Sharma taps it towards point for a single.

NO HAT-TRICK! What an opportunity that was for Rumana Ahmed to seal the hat-trick and get rid of Jemimah Rodrigues as well and she is devastated. This is tossed up around off, and Jemimah steps out and hammers it straight back to the bowler. The ball is travelling quickly and is really low as well. Rumana Ahmed tries to grab it with both hands but the ball goes through her legs and they get a single.

Another sloppy piece of fielding! This is tossed up outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues looks for the reverse sweep but mistimes it towards backward point. The batters think about one but decide against it. The throw is at the bowler's end but is wide and that allows the batters to get a single.
Sloppy fielding! Short and around off, Deepti Sharma punches it off the back foot towards cover where the fielder fumbles and aallows the single.
Outside off, this is swept away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Jemimah Rodrigues showing her class here! Loopy delivery, outside off and turning away. Rodrigues goes inside-out with the spin and hammers it over extra cover for a boundary.

TWO BYES! Tossed up, full and well outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues looks to shuffle across and sweep it away but misses. The keeper gets beaten due to the spin as well and the batters come back for two byes.
FOUR! Good hit! Tossed up around off, Jemimah Rodrigues comes down the track and thumps it straight back over the bowler's head for a boundary and a much-needed one as well for India Women.
Deepti Sharma is the next batter out in the middle.

OUT! TIMBER! Rumana Ahmed is on fire out there! This is nicely looped up, around middle and leg and on a nagging length as well. Kiran Navgire tries to play the slog-sweep on the very first delivery and that too against the turn. The ball though is a leg-spinner's dream delivery as it grips and turns away sharply. Navgire is beaten all ends up and the ball hits the top of off stump. Navgire is out for a golden duck and Rumana Ahmed will be on a hat-trick when she comes on to bowl next.
Kiran Navgire makes her way out to the midde.

OUT! TAKEN! The previous error doesn't hurt Bangladesh Women and this time, Rumana Ahmed does get the wicket. Nicely tossed up on off stump, Richa Ghosh goes deep in her crease and tries to force the big shot over long on. Ghosh is hitting against the turn and gets it off the toe end of the bat. The ball goes straight down the throat of the long on fielder Fargana Hoque who makes no mistake. Rumana Ahmed gets her second wicket and she now becomes the leading wicket-taker in the tournament.
Commentary.Howout: c Fargana Hoque b Rumana Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Shortish length, around off, hammered down to long off for a run.

In the air...lands safely! This is tossed up around middle, turning away from the right-hander. Richa Ghosh sets herself up for the slog-sweep but ends up mistiming it badly. The ball goes high and over mid-wicket. Three fielders converge but neither of them calls for it and the ball lands in between. A single is taken and this could be a costly error.
Tossed up, it is a full toss on middle. Jemimah Rodrigues steps out and just chips it down to long on for a single. The boundaries have completely dried up for India Women.
This is nicely looped up, full and well outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues gets right across the stumps and brooms it away towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
And again, no pace was offered by the bowler. This is shorter and around leg stump, Ghosh mistimes the pull towards square leg.
Slower and shorter, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues has to generate her own pace and pulls it down to wide long on for just another single.
WIDE! This is pushed well outside off and beyond the tramline. Jemimah Rodrigues is unable to reach it and a wide is called.
Nicely bowled! Fahima Khatun sees Richa Ghosh using her feet and just floats it up outside off. Ghosh adjusts and chops it down to short third man for a single.
Tossed up, outside off, kept out on the off side.
Floated up, full and outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues shuffles and drags the sweep shot towards deep mid-wicket for one more.
Tossed up, on a nagging length and turning away from off stump. Ghosh eases it in front of cover and scampers through for one.
Loops this one up, on a shorter length and well outside off. Richa Ghosh waits for it and taps it towards cover-point for a quick single.
Richa Ghosh walks out to bat now.

OUT! TIMBER! Bangladesh Women have the big wicket of Shafali Verma! She was looking dangerous and she has been dismissed playing an unnecessary shot. Rumana Ahmed flights this full and in line with the stumps, Shafali Verma steps across to the off side and goes for an audacious reverse sweep but misses the ball which goes on to shatter the stumps. The spinners are pulling Bangladesh Women back into this game as the opener departs after playing a wonderful inning.
This is slightly short and outside off, the ball stays really low as it goes through to the keeper.
Another full delivery flighted outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues strokes this to deep cover and takes a single.
This is full and heading for the leg stump, Shafali Verma works this to long on for an easy single.
FOUR! Shafali Verma continues her onslaught!
Rumana Ahmed to bowl for the first time in this game.
This is slightly short and outside off,  Jemimah Rodrigues looks to cut but is beaten. Just three runs from the over.
That is fifty for Shafali Verma! This is flighted as well and bowled full, Shafali Verma gets down the wicket and works this to long on for a run.
This is bowled much slower in the air and full outside off, Shafali Verma taps this back towards the bowler.
Loops this full on middle, Shafali Verma stokes this well but is unable to find the gap on the offside.
Flighted outside off on a shorter length, Jemimah Rodrigues cuts this towards point and takes one.
This is slightly short and in line with the stumps, the ball gets stuck in the wicket as she mistimes her shot towards long on for a run.
FOUR! Nicely done! Tossed up around middle, Jemimah Rodrigues gets down low quickly and sweeps it off the middle of the bat, past square leg for a boundary.
Short and around off, this is punched away off the back foot and towards long off for a single.

Nahida Akter bowls this full outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues hits this to cover and looks for a quick single. India Women have been poor with their running and this could have been yet another disaster. The throw is at the keeper's end and Shafali Verma stretches as she tries to get back in. Replays show that she has just made it in by a fraction.

Is that a run-out? There is a quick call for a single and the batters go through with it. The fielder at extra cover picks it up and throws it back to the keeper. Nigar Sultana whips off the bails and the decision has gone upstairs. The third umpire checks the replays and concludes that Shafali Verma was able to drag her bat back in time. NOT OUT!
This is a full toss in line with the stumps, Jemimah Rodrigues plays this towards point.
This is short and wide outside off, Shafali Verma cuts this to deep point for a run.
WIDE! This is way outside off, Shafali Verma leaves this alone and is called wide.
This is full and outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues works this to deep cover and gets off the mark straight away.
Jemimah Rodrigues walks in at number 3. Also, Nahida Akter (1-0-17-0) is back on.

OUT! RUN OUT! The dot ball pressure builds and Shafali Verma has run out her partner! Fahima Khatun continues bowling short and outside off, Shafali Verma hits this straight to the cover fielder and calls for a run. Smriti Mandhana responds but is sent back. She finds herself stranded in the middle of the wicket as the throw comes to the non-striker's end and the bowler takes the bails off. Shafali Verma has her hand on her head but Smriti Mandhana tells her it is okay as she walks off. India Women lose their first wicket and an outstanding partnership has finally been broken.
This is a touch short and outside off, Shafali Verma is unable to find the gap on the offside once again.
Another full delivery outside off, Shafali Verma slaps this straight towards cover.
Loopy delivery bowled full and on middle, Smriti Mandhana shimmies down the wicket and hits this uppishly as the ball gets stuck in the wicket. The take a single as the ball goes to long off.
This is outside off on a fuller length, Smriti Mandhana looks to cut but gets beaten.
A loopy delivery bowled a touch short and outside off, Shafali Verma rocks back and slaps this towards long off for a run.
Fahima Khatun has now been brought into the attack.
This is a fraction short and angled into the stumps, Smriti Mandhana blocks this back towards the bowler.
This is outside the off pole on a fuller length once again, Smriti Mandhana guides this late towards third man and picks up a brace.
Gets the ball to come back into the batter on a fuller length, Smriti Mandhana gets an inside edge towards mid-wicket. Three dot balls now.
Continues bowling full and outside off, Smriti Mandhana knocks this towards cover.
This is full as well and outside off, Smriti Mandhana guides this to the point fielder.
Sanjida Akter bowls this full and outside off, Shafali Verma strokes this to wide long off and takes one.

Drinks break! Time for a breather and Bangladesh Women certainly need it. The Indian opening pair of Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma have bossed play so far without taking many risks and they will now look to take on the bowling even more. Bangladesh Women do need a breakthrough and they need it soon or else they could be chasing a really big score. A fascinating phase awaits as a couple of wickets can change the momentum completely here.
This is in line with the stumps on a good length, Shafali Verma punches this to long on for a run and will keep strike.
WIDE! Way beyond the tram line on the off side. Shafali Verma leaves this alone and the umpire indicates wide.
This is on a fuller length and outside off, Shafali Verma strokes this towards cover.
SIX! Easy pickings! Ritu Moni bowls a low full toss on the pads, Shafali Verma clips this towards the deep square leg boundary for a maximum.
FOUR! Shafali Verma looking really good here! Ritu Moni bowls this full and outside off, Shafali Verma thumps this towards the cow corner fence for four runs.
Bowls this full as well and outside off, Smriti Mandhana strokes this to long off and takes a run.
This is full and outside off, Shafali Verma strokes this wide of cover for a single.
On the shorter side and around off, this is punched off the back foot and down to long off for just a single. India Women just milking the runs at the moment.
Tossed up, Verma comes down the pitch and flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Quicker and shorter, at the stumps, this is played off the back foot and back to the bowler as well.
Excellent fielding this time around. A tad bit short and around off, this is driven firmly towards cover where the fielder makes a diving stop. Just the single taken.
Flighted delivery, around off, Shafali Verma comes down the track and hammers it towards sweeper cover for a run.
Misfield! Floated up on a good length and around off. Mandhana hits it on the up and straight to the fielder at extra cover who fumbles, allowing an easy single.
Full and straight, this is stylishly driven down to straightish long off for one more.
Ritu Moni keeps it fuller and on off stump, Shafali Verma punches it on the up and back past the bowler for just another single.
Fullish length, around off and this is stroked away towards extra cover.
Pitches it up now and around off, Mandhana leans in and drives it through mid off for a single.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Ritu Moni comes from around the wicket and angles one into the hips. Smriti Mandhana pulls it one into the vacant boundary behind square leg.
Ritu Moni comes into the attack and starts off with a dragged-down delivery well outside off. Shafali Verma hits it straight down the ground and picks up a run.
The arm-ball almost does the trick! Sanjida Akter darts this one into middle and Shafali Verma does well to chop it towards cover-point and collect a single.
Shorter again and outside off, Mandhana cuts it firmly towards deep backward point for yet another single.
A fraction shorter and around off, Verma cuts it away in front of point and rotates the strike.
Tossed up around off, Smriti Mandhana just knocks it past the bowler and down to long off for one more.
Length, around off, pushed away towards cover.
Sanjida Akter comes back into the attack and slides one down the leg side, Smriti Mandhana stylishly tickles it down to fine leg for a couple of runs.
FOUR! A real gift! A juicy full toss around off, Shafali Verma stays put and slams it over wide mid off for a boundary. 17 off the over and after the Powerplay, India Women are 59/0!
Tossed up, full and around off, Shafali Verma looks to use her feet but can only manage to jam it out towards mid off.
Length, around off, Mandhan plays it late and towards the third man region for a single.

FOUR! Make that a hat-trick of boundaries now for Smriti Mandhana. Nahida drags it down around the pads, Mandhanaa swivel-pulls it behind square on the leg side for yet another boundary. India Women on fire at the moment.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Tossed up, around off, Smriti Mandhana skips down the track and hits it inside-out over extra cover for a boundary.
FOUR! Thumped! Nahida tosses it up first up, right in the slot. Smriti Mandhana gets down on one knee and slogs it away over wide mid on and picks up a boundary.
Nahida Akter has now been handed the ball.
On a nagging length and around off, Smriti Mandhana rocks back and eases it through cover-point to collect a single.
Flatter trajectory, around off, punched out towards extra cover.
On middle, Verma comes down the track yet again and forces it down to long on for a single.
Quicker and flatter, outside off. This is cut away off the back foot towards point.
Nicely flighted, around off, Shafali Verma skips down the track and pushes it towards covers.
Khatun floats it up on a length and outside off, Smriti Mandhana walks down the pitch and knocks it down to long off for a single.

FOUR! An expensive over from Fariha Trisna and India Women are off to a flier! Another loopy delivery asking to be hit on a fuller length. Shafali Verma obliges as she dispatches this towards deep mid-wicket for four more runs. 17 runs from the over.

FOUR! This is easy pickings for the India Women batter! Fariha Trisna vontinues to serve this full and outside off, Shafali Verma is down on one knee as she slogs this towards deep square leg for four runs.
This is wide outside the off pole on a fuller length, Shafali Verma thumps this straight to mid off.

SIX! That is the first maximum of the inning! Fariha Trishna flights this full and on middle and leg, Shafali Verma heaves this to the leg side and manages to clear the widish deep square leg boundary for six runs.
WIDE! This is served on a fullish length and way outside off, Shafali Verma leaves this alone and is called wide as well.
WIDE! This is straying down leg on a fuller length, Shafali Verma looks to sweep but misses and his called wide by the umpire.
Another short delivery in line with the stumps, Smriti Mandhana pulls this to deep square leg and collects a run.
Fariha Trisna floats this full and outside off, Smriti Mandhana hits this hard towards the bowler.
This is in line with the stump and on a shorter length, Shafali Verma goes back in the crease and tucks this to deep square leg for a couple of runs.
A fraction short and outside off, Shafali Verma pulls this back towards the bowler who gets a hand to it as the ball hits the stumps. Smriti Mandhana has her bat grounded at the non-striker's end.
This is angled into the pads on a fuller length. Smriti Mandhana clips this to deep mid-wicket for a run.
This is slightly short and outside off, Smriti Mandhana looks to cut but gets an under edge down into the pitch.
FOUR! Smriti Mandhana looks in fine touch here! Smriti Mandhana once again uses her feet to a full delivery outside the off pole and thrashes this towards deep cover-point for another boundary.
Salma Khatun flights this full and outside off, Smriti Mandhana knocks this towards cover.
An early bowling change as Salma Khatun is brought into the attack.
This is full as well and outside off, Smriti Mandhana works this to deep cover for a run and will keep strike.
This is full and angled into the stumps, Smriti Mandhana taps this towards mid on.
Bowls this short as well and in line with the stumps, Smriti Mandhana whips this towards short fine leg.
This is short and outside off, Smriti Mandhana cuts this to deep point for a couple of runs.

FOUR! Smriti Mandhana gets India Women their first boundary! Fariha Trisna floats this full and outside off, Smriti Mandhana is down the wicket in a flash and thumps it towards deep cover for a boundary.
This is bowled a fraction short and outside off, Shafali Verma pulls this to deep mid-wicket and takes a run.
Fariha Trisna to start from the opposite end.
This is slightly short and outside off, Smriti Mandhana cuts this late towards deep backward point for a couple of runs.

Sanjida Akter bowls this slightly short and outside the off pole, Shafali Verma is down the wicket once again and knocks this towards straightish long on. A good stop in the deep restricts them to a single.
Flights this one full and just outside off, Smriti Mandhana charges down the wicket and miscues her shot to deep mid-wicket for a single.
This is a fraction short and in line with the stumps, Smriti Mandhana knocks this back towards the bowler.
Loops this full and angled into the leg stump, Shafali Verma shimmies down the wicket and hits this to long on for a single.

Ouch! Shafali Verma gets caught in the firing line as the throw from the deep hits her flush on the left arm. She seems to be in a bit of pain but shrugs it off and sends the physio back. We are good to continue.
Sanjida Akter begins with a widish delivery served a fraction short, Shafali Verma works this past point for a couple of runs.

We are ready for play! The umpires are out in the middle and so are the players. Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana are the openers for India Women. Bangladesh Women opt to start with spin as Sanjida Akter has been handed the new ball. Let's play...

Nigar Sultana, the skipper of Bangladesh Women says that they wanted to bowl first as the bowlers have been doing well in the tournament. Mentions that If they could restrict the opponents below 130 it will be a good total to chase. Claims that they are not thinking too much and want to take it game by game. Adds that there is no pressure being the hosts or the reigning champions and want to take the confidence from the expectations people have in them. Informs that they have one change.

India Women captain, Smriti Mandhana  says that they will have a bat first. Adds that the wicket looks good to bat on and runs on the board are crucial and they do have a good bowling unit as well. Mentions that the last game they thought about the batting order but they want to bat to their strengths. Reckons anything above 140 will be good and 170-180 would be a surplus. Informs that Harmanpreet Kaur, Dayalan Hemalatha, Radha Yadav and Meghna Singh all miss out.

PITCH REPORT - Athar Ali Khan says it's the same pitch used in the previous two games and the sun is out. The pitch has dried out and will be good for batting but the spinners will have a say as well. Reckons that the Indian batters look to use their feet and hence the lengths of the spinners will be crucial.

Bangladesh Women (Playing XI) - Murshida Khatun, Fargana Hoque, Nigar Sultana (C & WK), Ritu Moni, Lata Mondal (In place of Shamima Sultana), Fahima Khatun, Rumana Ahmed, Salma Khatun, Nahida Akter, Fariha Trisna, Sanjida Akter.

India Women (Playing XI) - Smriti Mandhana (C), Shafali Verma (In place of Harmanpreet Kaur), Jemimah Rodrigues, Sabbhineni Meghana, Deepti Sharma, Richa Ghosh (WK), Sneh Rana (In place of Dayalan Hemalatha), Renuka Singh, Pooja Vastrakar, Rajeshwari Gayakwad, Kiran Navgire (In place of Radha Yadav).
TOSS - The captains are out in the middle. The coin is flipped into the air and lands in favor of India Women. They have elected to BAT first.
